Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling
of the left wrist. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a distal radius
fracture consistent with the reported mechanism. Causation of this injury relative to
the collision is not yet clear and should be considered in light of the full history.
The patient reports a remote minor strain to the same region, which resolved
completely without residual limitation. Treatment followed a usual course, including
immobilization, orthopedic follow-up, progressive range-of-motion and strengthening
therapy, and home exercise instruction. Over the cousre of 30 visits, the patient's
symptoms steadily improved and care tapered as function returned. Billing records
reflect single, non-duplicated charges for services rendered. At discharge from active
care, the patient was advised to continue a home program and to return if symptoms
recur.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
